name: zdeclient_load_material_from_texture_path
description: zDEClient::LoadOrCreateMaterialFromTexturePath returns an existing material for a known texture path or appends the texture path and creates a default material for a missing path.
known_limits: VC5SP3 zdeclient_load_config_resources verifies 0x455dd0 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 20 relocation bytes and 11 trimmed VC5 NOPs, but owner-level tier S remains blocked by sibling 0x4558f0.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x455dd0 validates lookup by texture path, returning an existing material for a found texture-directory entry, appending a missing path and returning one, creating a default flagged material when no material exists, and storing the selected material through outMaterial.

The native smoke verifies the existing-texture reuse path and the missing-texture append/clone path, including result codes, texture-directory count/state, material flag bit, and material pool active/free list effects.
